## What changed?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include `bun run check` and any relevant Mac UI or live CLI verification. State what remains unverified.

For visual changes, include a screenshot with private details removed.

## Risks and trade-offs

Describe any effects on stored data, authentication, permissions, provider compatibility, or usage. Write "None" if this change has no material impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing code style.
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that failed before the fix, where applicable.
- [ ] Setup, behavior, or compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private launch URLs, local libraries, or generated bundles are included.
